ollie_keys0.text: Oh no! I lost my 3 golden keys! Can you find them? Look for the golden lights in the sky!

ollie_keys1.text: You found one key! Keep looking. Follow the golden lights!

ollie_keys2.text: You found two keys! Keep looking. Follow the golden lights!

ollie_keys3.text: You found all my keys! Now touch the treasure chest to open it!

ollie_lookbook.text: Oh, look what else is in there! My Dragon Book!

ollie_getbook.text: Go and pick up my Dragon Book! It's right by the chest.

ollie_book.text: My old Dragon Book! Look up! The dragons are coming down to land!

ollie_landed.text: The dragons have landed! Walk up to a dragon and press E to look at it in your Dragon Book. Each one needs your help.

ollie_follow.text: Follow the colored lights to find what the dragons need. You can do it!

n_egg.text: You found a warm dragon egg! Take it up to the volcano's crater.

n_gems.text: You found all 5 gems! Bring them to Glimmer.

n_flower.text: You picked the moon flower! Bring it to Frost.

n_asleep.text: The moon flower is still asleep. Come back at night!

n_full.text: Your hands are full! Deliver what you are carrying first.

n_trust_ember.text: Ember is so happy! Stay close so it learns to trust you.

n_trust_glimmer.text: Glimmer is so happy! Stay close so it learns to trust you.

n_trust_frost.text: Frost is so happy! Stay close so it learns to trust you.

n_keeper.text: Hooray! You are a real Dragon Keeper!

n_wait.text: Help Grandpa Ollie find his keys first. Then the dragons will come down.

n_hint_frost.text: Follow the blue light. The flower only opens at night.

n_has_egg.text: You have the egg! Walk up to Ember to give it back.

n_has_flower.text: You have the flower! Walk up to Frost to give it.

n_has_gems.text: You have all 5 gems! Walk up to Glimmer.

n_quest_done.text: Done! Now stay close so it can trust you.

ember_want.text: I lost my egg! Can you find it in the forest?

ember_thanks.text: My egg! You found my egg! Thank you!

glimmer_want.text: I love shiny things! Can you bring me 5 sparkly gems?

glimmer_thanks.text: Ooh, so sparkly! Thank you, thank you!

frost_want.text: Please bring me a moon flower. It only blooms at night, by a lake.

frost_thanks.text: A moon flower. It is so beautiful. Thank you, friend.

ollie_race.text: Wow, you made friends with all three dragons! Now ride a dragon through my magic ring. It goes to the Sky Pitch!

ollie_village0.text: What a flyer! Now the villagers need help. Follow the lights to find them. Each one needs a different dragon!

ollie_village1.text: Keep going! Some villagers still need your help.

ollie_final.text: You helped everyone! You are the best Dragon Keeper ever!

n_race_call.text: Grandpa Ollie has a surprise for you! Go and see him.

n_race_ride.text: Climb on a dragon, then fly through the magic ring!

n_race_welcome.text: Welcome to the Sky Pitch! Fly through all the golden rings. Ready?

n_race_middle.text: Now down the middle and through the big hoop!

n_race_done.text: You did it! What a flyer!

n_finale.text: Hooray! Every villager is happy, and every dragon is your friend!

max_want.text: It's the big village party tonight, but the giant bonfire won't light! Can a fire dragon help?

max_wrong.text: That bonfire needs fire! Ember breathes fire.

max_thanks.text: Hooray! The bonfire is lit! Let the party begin! Thank you!

ivy_want.text: It's so hot today and my ice-cream cart has no ice left! Can an ice dragon help?

ivy_wrong.text: My cart needs ice! Frost breathes ice.

ivy_thanks.text: Brrr, lovely and cold! Ice cream for everyone! Thank you!

sam_want.text: I made a stone dragon statue, but it's so plain and grey. Can a sparkly dragon make it shine?

sam_wrong.text: My statue needs to sparkle! Glimmer breathes diamonds.

sam_thanks.text: Wow! A diamond dragon! It's the most beautiful statue ever! Thank you!

n_open_ember.text: A new land is open! Follow the path to the Fire Mountains!

n_nest_ember.text: You found Ember's nest! Look at all the eggs!

n_locked_ember.text: This way is closed. Make friends with Ember to open it!

n_open_glimmer.text: A new land is open! Follow the path to the Crystal Forest!

n_nest_glimmer.text: You found Glimmer's nest! Look at all the eggs!

n_locked_glimmer.text: This way is closed. Make friends with Glimmer to open it!

n_open_frost.text: A new land is open! Follow the path to the Frozen Land!

n_nest_frost.text: You found Frost's nest! Look at all the eggs!

n_locked_frost.text: This way is closed. Make friends with Frost to open it!

mama_want.text: Oh dear, oh dear! My five little chicks wandered off in the snow. Can you find them and bring them home?

mama_more.text: You found some of my chicks! Please find the rest of them.

mama_thanks.text: My babies! All five are home! Thank you!

mama_skate.text: Now let's have a skating party! Can Frost freeze the big lake for us?

mama_party.text: Wheee! Look at us skate! Thank you, friend! The Penguin King at the ice castle wants to meet you.

king_early.text: Hello, little traveler! Have you helped Mama Penguin yet?

king_want.text: Oh, woe! I lost my crown on top of the snowy peak. Only a flying dragon can reach it. Will you fetch it?

king_thanks.text: My crown! Thank you! I name you an honorary penguin! Here is a crown of your own!

n_chick.text: You found a penguin chick! It's following you!

n_lake.text: The lake is frozen! Let's skate!

n_crown.text: You got the crown! Take it back to the Penguin King.

flicker_want.text: Oh no! My fire sprite friends have gone cold and sleepy. Can Ember breathe fire to warm them up?

flicker_more.text: You warmed some of my friends! Please find the others. They look grey and sleepy.

flicker_thanks.text: Hooray! We're all warm again! Let's dance!

flicker_river.text: I have a secret treasure on the island in the lava river. Dragons can't land there, it's too hot! Can Frost make stepping stones?

flicker_egg.text: You found it! That is a fire dragon egg. It needs the heat of the volcano to hatch. Fly it up to the crater!

flicker_done.text: Your baby dragon is so cute! Come and dance with us any time!

n_sprite.text: You warmed up a fire sprite!

n_egg_set.text: Now breathe fire on the egg with Ember!

n_hatch.text: The egg is hatching! It's a baby dragon!

n_sprite_wrong.text: Brrr! Sleepy sprites need Ember's fire!

n_egg_fire.text: Breathe fire on the egg with Ember!

n_sprites_first.text: Help Flicker warm up the fire sprites first!

luna_want.text: Hello, friend! My crystals have gone dull and grey. Can Glimmer breathe her sparkly diamonds on them to make them shine?

luna_more.text: They are starting to shine! Please find the other dull crystals.

luna_song.text: My forest sparkles again! Now come to the song glade. Watch the singing crystals light up, then walk to them in the same order.

luna_oops.text: Oops! Watch the lights and try again.

luna_star.text: What a beautiful song! Here is the star crystal. Fly it up to the very top of the giant crystal tree!

luna_done.text: The whole forest is glowing! Thank you! Now you leave rainbow sparkles wherever you go!

n_crystals.text: All the crystals shine! Now go to the song glade.

n_song_how.text: Watch the crystals light up, then walk to them in the same order!

n_star.text: The star is on the tree! The whole forest is glowing!

n_crystal_wrong.text: Dull crystals need sparkly diamonds! Glimmer breathes diamonds.
